rules: Every team member must be eligible/enrolled for the practical course or activity.
Specialization-aligned teams use real specialization/branch state and do not infer branch from species/personality.
Cross-branch teams seek functional academic diversity when the eligible roster supports it.
Fourth/Third Class may use branch interests only where a course explicitly allows exploratory grouping; branch interest remains nonbinding.
Team membership and team role are separate; exercise-specific roles may be assigned by the practical activity.
A practical team does not create interpersonal relationship state automatically.
Team changes require an academic/activity event rather than player proximity.
Scheduling and physical co-presence are resolved later; team membership alone does not teleport anyone.
